events.title: Van Vorst Neighborhood Association Meeting
events.description: The Van Vorst Neighborhood Association meets monthly at the Barrow Mansion. Join us from 6:30pm – 7:00pm for a mixer. At 7:00pm the meeting begins. Come to learn about important issues affecting your community. Everyone is welcome!
